posts.text: This summer, I had the incredible opportunity to intern at Loblaws Head Office in Mississauga. While there I had the chance to learn, grow, and contribute in a meaningful way. A special thank you to Shahzil Qidwai, her team and the broader HMR team for welcoming me with open arms. Each and every person on this team is a mentor to me, the guidance and support I received will last me a lifetime. I also want to thank my fellow interns, I truly appreciated the great friendships we built and the memo

I’m excited to share that I’ve accepted an internship as an Associate Merchant at Loblaws Corporate. I’m looking forward to learning about the world of retail merchandising, working with talented teams, and gaining hands-on experience in a corporate setting. A big thanks to everyone who’s supported me along the way. I’m excited for the opportunity to grow and contribute, and I can’t wait to see what this next chapter holds. #BringYourDifference #MakeYourDifference
